fullReactor.notes: Sequential completion run on final production and test sources; includes missing-pin startup rejection, all seven native assertions and identity/approval/HTTP integration

finalTargeted.notes: Includes final constructor rejection when a structured policy requires a tool binding without the pinned lease; all other production sources unchanged

documentation.notes: Three existing unrelated anchor-link INFO messages; no warnings in successful strict build

capabilities.approvalSource: Fixed host-reviewed descriptor, not automatically approving current provider data
capabilities.artifact: Actual supplied bytes match fixed sha256, copied before checking and retained within a total catalog budget; host loader must consume immutable snapshot
capabilities.specification: Complete LC4j ToolSpecification JSON, including description/parameters/metadata/strict, frozen and matched before exposure
capabilities.policy: Optional ToolRule.binding, null omission preserves old signed policy fingerprints; explicit fixed AgentControl lease set, startup rejects missing pins
capabilities.dispatch: Opaque local lease object required; ordinary JSON or another catalog cannot substitute; rechecked after prepare and before post-result delivery
capabilities.approval: PolicyRequest.toolBinding and ActionIdentity include actual descriptor digest; real authenticated session and encrypted approval preserve it to HTTP tool execution
capabilities.revocation: Local irreversible revoke/close, enforcement-mode requirement, suppressed late async and native callback delivery; no rollback of prior side effects
capabilities.limits: 1-128 tools, <=64KiB specification projection, configured 1-16777216 total retained artifact bytes, same-name registration reused after rechecking
capabilities.privacy: Lease/artifact excluded from model parameters and audit target; tool_binding digest added to audit warnings
